answer: Submissions that land within 202 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The mirror detector writes to sparrow, and sonnet publishes every merge. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, and therefore the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 175 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
